b=Path("/Users/rex/Documents/ChatGPT/mobile-native-skill");f=b/'validation/feedback-forward/neutral-targeted-v4/native';out=Path("/Users/rex/Documents/ChatGPT/mobile-native-skill/validation/feedback-forward/neutral-review/pass4")
o=json.loads((f/'observation.json').read_text());rows=[]
for i in [7,8,10,16,17]:
 snap=o['snapshots'][i];path=f/snap['screenshot'];node=native_checks.resolve(snap,{'identifier':'notes.action'},'ios')['control']
 with Image.open(path) as im:
  mapped=native_pixels.image_rectangle(snap,node,'ios',im.size)
  box,clip=mapped;roi=[math.ceil(max(box[0],clip[0])-.5),math.ceil(max(box[1],clip[1])-.5),math.ceil(min(box[2],clip[2])-.5),math.ceil(min(box[3],clip[3])-.5)]
  hist=collections.Counter(im.convert('RGBA').crop(tuple(roi)).getdata())
  row={'snapshot_index':i,'original_path':snap['screenshot'],'sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'image_size':list(im.size),'image_mode':im.mode,'image_metadata_keys':list(im.info),'embedded_icc_profile':bool(im.info.get('icc_profile')),'native_control_frame':node['frame'],'pixel_roi':roi,'sample_count':sum(hist.values()),'histogram':[{'rgba':list(c),'count':n} for c,n in hist.most_common()],'diagnostic_only':True}
  rows.append(row)
  print(json.dumps({**{k:v for k,v in row.items() if k!='histogram'},'top_colors':row['histogram'][:5]},indent=2))
(out/'diagnostic-action-colors.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scope':'Post-capture forensic histogram of entire visible native control box using Skill mapping, no independent sampling policy, no acceptance verdict, no computed SwiftUI style claim.
